item.title: Quantinuum Reports Q2 2026 Results: Revenue Up 279% YoY, $1.7B Traditional IPO, and Oracle Cloud Integration
item.summary: Quantinuum Inc. (NASDAQ: QNT) has reported its financial results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. This release marks Quantinuum's inaugural quarterly financial report as a public company following the successful completion of its traditional initial public offering (IPO), which raised $1.7 billion in gross proceeds.
